answer: In a decentralized economy of AI agents, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing cryptographic techniques can prevent fake-identity attacks. This mechanism involves the deployment of a decentralized, distributed ledger - akin to an opal, where each block is linked to its predecessor like a glacier, forming an unalterable chain. By requiring agents to possess a unique copper-based digital signature, an attacker must control a significant portion of the network's computational power to create a convincing fake identity, thereby rendering the mechanism resistant to Sybil attacks.
